scope: Independent source-free contributor; no owner-state actions or canonical Yggdrasil training
central_integration: Unified Causal Intelligence Amalgam Work chat only / PR #1278
hypothesis: From four previously unseen public context variables with typed names and two action-role identifiers, an additive source-only learner can identify a truly relevant fourth variable by witnessed intervention consequences; it will outperform a frozen no-fourth-variable ablation on disjoint new laws while retaining preexisting old context capability.

study_design.observed_actions: Fixed random public seed tape for OLD_FIT, NEW_FIT, VALID and HELD_SHARED; held policy actions genuinely selected per arm, each choice sees only its own realized outcomes; no counterfactual trainer inputs.
study_design.held_source: unseen stable phase-index IDs reserved; pilot excludes any primary seed
study_design.feature_discovery: Boolean functions over all typed public context factors and currently observed action/current intermediate state; deduplicate by exact 2^k truth-table signature. Source must supply all values and identities without relevance labels.
study_design.grammar: Constants, literals/NOT, parity of <=4 public inputs, two-input AND/OR, and (two-input AND/OR) XOR a third input. Cost = 0 for constants, 1 literal, n-1 for n parity, 2 for pair AND/OR, 3 for compound; no future labels or private law in hypotheses.
study_design.candidate: MAP with empirical posterior support over all grammar hypotheses; only allow fourth-variable causal identity if posterior support and out-of-class predictive fit meet frozen thresholds
study_design.policy: For held policy evaluate all possible binary first actions using learned transition probabilities, conditional second actions using learned reward probabilities; optimize expected observed reward before feedback; tie prefer zero.
negative_controls: x3 has no observed variation and is not identifiable
nonrepresentable source law must not hallucinate certainty

qualification.pass_representation: For each of four novel families in at least 3/4 new seeds, posterior support of x3 >=0.90 after NEW_FIT; stage2 also has a complete public state transition witness before prediction; novel-family mean prequential HELD Brier at least 10% lower than NO_FOURTH_FACTOR_EXACT_BMA and no >0.02 absolute OLD_RETURN Brier worsening versus frozen OLD model.
qualification.pass_scientific_dev: Separate and stronger: candidate HELD_SHARED Brier at least 5% lower than strongest VALID-selected fully fitted same-public-factor control in at least 3/4 novel families, plus positive action reward delta in at least 3/4 novel families; same source/witness/compute/memory within declared budgets; no OLD_RETURN drift >+0.02; controls include independent conventional fit. This source-free DEV alone cannot be SCIENTIFIC_PASS.
qualification.failure: Any unmet threshold = DEV_NO_GO for that gate. Report direct and control scores, per-seed outcomes, abstention counts, action counts, peak memory/CPU, and seed consumption; no post-result fixes.
qualification.uncertainty_rule: When posterior x3 support <0.90 or latest 24 prequential rewards have Brier >0.15, return UNKNOWN; do not invent a new relation identity.
qualification.negative_rule: In unidentifiable_x3, fourth-variable discovery must be UNKNOWN. Outside grammar must be UNKNOWN or fail the negative gate; report if not.
qualification.reproducibility: GitHub source files and preflight verified at an immutable commit BEFORE primary scoring; prereg HEAD strictly ancestor of source commit; source and result separate commits; no source retuning on primary seeds.
qualification.runtime: Source-free isolated Python stdlib only; no native checkpoint access, no protected source, no new owner or controller
qualification.side_effects: Research data only; no accepted model weights, checkpoint, owner ref, first-use or deployment
